s0401.literal: Now that they have come to submit, generous gifts should be bestowed to settle them."
s0401.idiomatic: Now that they have come to submit, generous gifts should be bestowed to settle them."

s0402.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on xinmao new moon, Xuanzheng Commissioner Qinchatai personally transmitted an edict and assumed affairs; the Central Secretariat held this improper by regulation and requested a general prohibition — approved.
s0402.idiomatic: Autumn, seventh month, on xinmao new moon, Xuanzheng commissioner Qinchatai personally transmitted an edict and assumed affairs; the Central Secretariat held this improper by regulation and requested a general prohibition — approved.

s0403.literal: On renchen day the king of Champa sent his younger brother Baoyou Balazhe to present a memorial and offer tribute goods.
s0403.idiomatic: On renchen day the king of Champa sent his younger brother Baoyou Balazhe to present a memorial and offer tribute goods.

s0404.literal: The postal-households of Zhending Circuit suffered famine; 2,400 shi of grain was granted in relief.
s0404.idiomatic: The postal-households of Zhending Circuit suffered famine; 2,400 shi of grain was granted in relief.

s0405.literal: On guimao day the Imperial Ancestral Temple was completed.
s0405.idiomatic: On guimao day the Imperial Ancestral Temple was completed.

s0406.literal: Bandan was flogged and dismissed from office on charges of corruption.
s0406.idiomatic: Bandan was flogged and dismissed from office on charges of corruption.

s0407.literal: 468,000 ingots of notes were granted to impoverished peasants of Latu garrison-farm to buy oxen and farm implements.
s0407.idiomatic: 468,000 ingots of notes were granted to impoverished peasants of Latu garrison-farm to buy oxen and farm implements.

s0408.literal: On jiachen day Prince Temür returned from Yunnan; after eight days on palace guard duty he was granted 25,000 ingots of notes.
s0408.idiomatic: On jiachen day Prince Temür returned from Yunnan; after 8 days on palace guard duty he was granted 25,000 ingots of notes.

s0409.literal: On yisi day amnesties and summons were issued to Huang Shengxu and Cen Shixing of the Left and Right Two Rivers.
s0409.idiomatic: On yisi day amnesties and summons were issued to Huang Shengxu and Cen Shixing of the Left and Right Two Rivers.

s0410.literal: On jiyou day Prince Qutu Temür was enfeoffed as Prince Weiyuan and granted a gold seal.
s0410.idiomatic: On jiyou day Prince Qutu Temür was enfeoffed as Prince Weiyuan and granted a gold seal.

s0411.literal: The annual grain transport by sea route was reduced by 200,000 shi, and the additional levies on Jiang-Huai grain were also remitted.
s0411.idiomatic: The annual grain transport by sea route was reduced by 200,000 shi, and the additional levies on Jiang-Huai grain were also remitted.

s0412.literal: On jiayin day 650 horses were purchased for the imperial carriage train.
s0412.idiomatic: On jiayin day 650 horses were purchased for the imperial carriage train.

s0413.literal: On bingchen day Prince Yongning Buyan Temür acted unlawfully; the Imperial Clan Court and palace attendants were ordered jointly to try his tutor.
s0413.idiomatic: On bingchen day Prince Yongning Buyan Temür acted unlawfully; the Imperial Clan Court and palace attendants were ordered jointly to try his tutor.

s0414.literal: Temüder's household property was registered and confiscated.
s0414.idiomatic: Temüder's household property was registered and confiscated.

s0415.literal: Prince Cheche Tu came to court requesting a seal; the Emperor, holding that his achievements were not yet distinguished, did not approve, but granted 250,000 ingots of notes.
s0415.idiomatic: Prince Cheche Tu came to court requesting a seal; the Emperor, holding that his achievements were not yet distinguished, did not approve, but granted 250,000 ingots of notes.

s0416.literal: The Censorate requested an edict opening the avenue of remonstrance; the Emperor said, "The avenue of remonstrance has never been closed — only you have not selected the right men.
s0416.idiomatic: The Censorate requested an edict opening the avenue of remonstrance; the Emperor said, "The avenue of remonstrance has never been closed — only you have not selected the right men.

s0417.literal: " Huozhou rain; floodwater damaged garrison-farm crops.
s0417.idiomatic: " On Huozhou, rain flooded and damaged garrison-farm crops.

s0418.literal: Dependent counties of Zhending Prefecture's various circuits had locusts; dependent counties of the three circuits of Jining, Xinghe, and Datong had frost fall.
s0418.idiomatic: Dependent counties of Zhending Prefecture's various circuits had locusts; dependent counties of the 3 circuits of Jining, Xinghe, and Datong had frost fall.

s0419.literal: The Eastern Route Mongol wanhu office suffered famine; two months' grain was granted in relief.
s0419.idiomatic: The Eastern Route Mongol wanhu office suffered famine; 2 months' grain was granted in relief.

s0420.literal: Emperor Yingzong was resolute and clear-sighted. Once when an earthquake occurred, he reduced his meals, withdrew music, and avoided the main hall; a close minister raised a cup to congratulate him, whereupon he asked, "What is there to congratulate?
s0420.idiomatic: Emperor Yingzong was resolute and clear-sighted. Once when an earthquake occurred, he reduced his meals, withdrew music, and avoided the main hall; a close minister raised a cup to congratulate him, whereupon he asked, "What is there to congratulate?

s0421.literal: I am still occupied with cultivating virtue — you are a great minister, yet instead of assisting me you flatter me?
s0421.idiomatic: I am still occupied with cultivating virtue — you are a great minister, yet instead of assisting me you flatter me?

s0422.literal: " He had him dismissed and expelled.
s0422.idiomatic: " He had him dismissed and expelled.

s0423.literal: Baizhu stepped forward and said, "The earthquake is due to our ministers' dereliction of duty; worthy men should be sought to replace us.
s0423.idiomatic: Baizhu stepped forward and said, "The earthquake is due to our ministers' dereliction of duty; worthy men should be sought to replace us.

s0424.literal: " He said, "Do not over-disclaim — this is my fault.
s0424.idiomatic: " He said, "Do not over-disclaim — this is my fault.

s0425.literal: " Once he admonished the multitude of ministers, saying, "You hold high office and receive generous stipends — you should strive with all your strength to repay the state.
s0425.idiomatic: " Once he admonished the multitude of ministers, saying, "You hold high office and receive generous stipends — you should strive with all your strength to repay the state.

s0426.literal: If any among you are in want, I do not begrudge bestowing gifts upon you;
s0426.idiomatic: If any among you are in want, I do not begrudge bestowing gifts upon you;

s0427.literal: but if you act unlawfully, punishment shall certainly be without pardon.
s0427.idiomatic: but if you act unlawfully, punishment shall certainly be without pardon.

s0428.literal: " When Basijisi was imprisoned, he said to those at hand, "Law is what the ancestors established — it is not mine to apply privately.
s0428.idiomatic: " When Basijisi was imprisoned, he said to those at hand, "Law is what the ancestors established — it is not mine to apply privately.

s0429.literal: Though Basijisi has long served me, now that he is guilty he should be judged according to law.
s0429.idiomatic: Though Basijisi has long served me, now that he is guilty he should be judged according to law.

s0430.literal: " Once, holding court at Deer-top Hall, he said to Baizhu, "I succeeded to the great enterprise in my youth and inexperience — brocade robes and jade fare, what could I not obtain?
s0430.idiomatic: " Once, holding court at Deer-top Hall, he said to Baizhu, "I succeeded to the great enterprise in my youth and inexperience — brocade robes and jade fare, what could I not obtain?

s0431.literal: Only my ancestors, enduring wind and rain, subdued the myriad regions — did they ever have such pleasures?
s0431.idiomatic: Only my ancestors, enduring wind and rain, subdued the myriad regions — did they ever have such pleasures?

s0432.literal: You are descended from founding ministers — you should embody my deepest intent and not disgrace your forebears.
s0432.idiomatic: You are descended from founding ministers — you should embody my deepest intent and not disgrace your forebears.

s0433.literal: " Baizhu kowtowed and replied, "Founding an enterprise is arduous; preserving it is not easy — that Your Majesty's wise thought reaches thus far is the fortune of the hundred millions.
s0433.idiomatic: " Baizhu kowtowed and replied, "Founding an enterprise is arduous; preserving it is not easy — that Your Majesty's wise thought reaches thus far is the fortune of the hundred millions.

s0434.literal: " He again said to the great ministers, "The Central Secretariat selects a man to assume office, and before ten days have passed the Censorate replaces him.
s0434.idiomatic: " He again said to the great ministers, "The Central Secretariat selects a man to assume office, and before 10 days have passed the Censorate replaces him.

s0435.literal: When the Censorate appoints someone, the Central Secretariat does the same in turn.
s0435.idiomatic: When the Censorate appoints someone, the Central Secretariat does the same in turn.

s0436.literal: Now beneath the mountains and forests there are many reclusive talents — can you not earnestly seek them out, but only mutually recommend relatives and old friends?
s0436.idiomatic: Now beneath the mountains and forests there are many reclusive talents — can you not earnestly seek them out, but only mutually recommend relatives and old friends?

s0437.literal: " Such was his clarity and decisiveness.
s0437.idiomatic: " Such was his clarity and decisiveness.

s0438.literal: Yet because he was resolute in inflicting punishment, the villain faction feared execution and thus engineered the great mutiny — so it is said.
s0438.idiomatic: Yet because he was resolute in inflicting punishment, the villain faction feared execution and thus engineered the great mutiny — so it is said.
